blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Jim drove too fast, which was reckless.
exercises.why: **вёл** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.ru: Джим ___ слишком быстро, и это было безрассудно.

exercises.q: Can you drive a car with manual transmission?
exercises.why: **водить** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: вести).
exercises.ru: Вы умеете ___ машину с механической коробкой передач?

exercises.q: Мы все ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) свой крест.
exercises.why: **несём** — present tense (1st person plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: We all have our cross to bear.

exercises.q: Том ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) Мэри на спине.
exercises.why: **нес** — past tense (masculine) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: Tom carried Mary on his back.

exercises.q: Он ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) бурную жизнь.
exercises.why: **ведет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Ослы ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) тяжёлые вьюки.
exercises.why: **несли** — past tense (plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: The donkeys were carrying heavy packs.

exercises.q: Застой ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) к упадку.
exercises.why: **ведёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Я ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) сына на закорках.
exercises.why: **нёс** — past tense (masculine) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: I carried my son on my back.

exercises.q: Эта дверь ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) в сад.
exercises.why: **ведет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: This door leads to the garden.

exercises.q: Я впервые ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) машину.
exercises.why: **вела** — past tense (feminine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: That was the first time I drove a car.

exercises.q: Они странно себя ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way).
exercises.why: **вели** — past tense (plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Чувак, хватит ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) херню.
exercises.why: **нести** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя как мужчина.
exercises.why: **веди** — imperative (ты, singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя естественно.
exercises.why: **ведите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Он ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) сына на закорках.
exercises.why: **нёс** — past tense (masculine) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: He carried his son on his back.

exercises.q: Везёт тому, кто ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way).
exercises.why: **везёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Боже, какой вздор я ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way)!
exercises.why: **несу** — present tense (1st person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: Oh dear, what nonsense I'm talking!

exercises.q: Ступеньки ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) наверх.
exercises.why: **вели** — past tense (plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя естественно.
exercises.why: **веди** — imperative (ты, singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Он ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) на плече винтовку.
exercises.why: **нес** — past tense (masculine) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: He carried a rifle on his shoulder.
